settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Give with food once a day. Under 25 lb: 1 chew. 25 to 75 lb: 2 chews. Over 75 lb: 3 chews.

settings.title: Made for older dogs
settings.text: Daily support for joints, energy, coat and digestion as your dog ages.

settings.title: Tastes like a treat
settings.text: Soft chicken-flavored chews, easy on older teeth. No pill pockets.

settings.question: How long does one jar last?
settings.answer: 90 chews per jar. That's 90 days for a small dog, 45 for a medium dog and 30 for a large dog.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 5–8 business days.

settings.question: Can my dog take it with medication?
settings.answer: If your dog is on prescription medication or has a health condition, check with your vet before starting any supplement.
